# Camille Styles

> A lifestyle and wellness platform offering curated content on interior design, healthy recipes, and science-backed wellness advice with a focus on minimalist, organic modern living.

Camille Styles is a comprehensive lifestyle brand covering interior design (with a specialty in Japandi and minimalist aesthetics), food and recipes (500+ searchable recipes), and wellness topics. The site features Camille's personal home renovation projects, expert interviews, and seasonal trends across all categories.

## Key Topics

- Interior Design
- Japandi Style
- Minimalist Home Decor
- Healthy Recipes
- Meal Prep
- Wellness
- Nutrition
- Morning Routines
- Home Tours
- Seasonal Trends
- Home Organization
- Organic Modern Design
- Wabi-Sabi
- Wellness Nutrition
- Home Renovation

## Core Lifestyle Hubs

- [Camille Styles](https://camillestyles.com): Homepage covering lifestyle, design, food, style, travel & wellness
- [Subscribe to the Newsletter - Camille Styles](https://camillestyles.com/subscribe): Newsletter signup for exclusive Camille Styles content & updates
- [Minimalist + Wabi-Sabi Interior Design Ideas for a Welcoming Home](https://camillestyles.com/design): Interior design hub with minimalist & wabi-sabi home ideas
- [Recipe Ideas for a Healthy Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner](https://camillestyles.com/food): Food hub with healthy recipes, cooking tips & meal ideas
- [Expert Wellness Tips, Trends, and Product Reviews Backed By Science](https://camillestyles.com/wellness): Wellness hub with science-backed tips, trends & product reviews
